title: Filling the holes in whole genomes: A vision for personalized genomics from telomere to telomere.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access in Europe PMC, no supplement, no accessions in text or text-mined, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject), no Zenodo/Dryad hits on the DOI.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: a vision/perspective piece arguing that complete telomere-to-telomere (T2T, gap-free end-to-end) genomes should be used to train predictive genome models. It describes no dataset of its own.

a1_downloadable.note: Perspective article with no deposited data: no supplement, no accessions, no repository links found (checked via paper_context.py).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No data table exists, so there is no label column; any target would have to be built from outside resources such as T2T assemblies.

a3_inputs_present.note: No inputs are provided by the paper.

a5_enough_rows.note: No rows: there is no dataset.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Not applicable: no data. Whole T2T genome resources would also be genomics-scale.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not applicable: no counts to compare.

honest_claim_h3: None: the paper supplies no data, so no model claim can rest on it.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use complete, gap-free human genome sequences to predict gene activity or variant effects in regions older genome builds missed.
plain_idea.train_on: DNA sequence from complete telomere-to-telomere genome assemblies; this paper provides none, so the number of examples is unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Some genome readout such as expression or variant effect, measured in other resources; this paper defines no target.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Genome-model builders would learn whether the newly resolved regions add predictive signal, but the data would have to come from elsewhere.

ml_idea: None from this paper. A real project would need T2T resources such as the CHM13 or Human Pangenome Reference Consortium assemblies, evaluated as their own candidates.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already failed: no data is attached to or linked from the paper.

verdict_reason: Perspective/vision article with no dataset, supplement or accessions, so Part A1 (downloadable data) fails.
